major_cooldowns.name: Evangelism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Start your ramp 8 seconds before the damage lands and chain the two instant Power Word: Radiance casts it grants.

major_cooldowns.name: Ultimate Penitence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for a heavy damage window away from Evangelism, leading with Mind Blast as Voidweaver and spell queuing Void Shield just before the cast ends.

major_cooldowns.name: Mindbender
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it while your Atonements are out so its damage converts into healing.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Two live Mindbender ids share the name: 123040 (12s tooltip, the Discipline pet) and 200174 (10s). Neither was cast in the sampled parses and the guide never names the pet; Shadowfiend appears only as self aura 1280172 with no cast id in the table.

defensives.name: Desperate Prayer
defensives.usage_rule: Press it when your own health drops so you can keep casting through the damage.

defensives.name: Pain Suppression
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it on an ally taking heavy damage when you have no healing cooldown available.

defensives.name: Power Word: Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Place it under the stacked group for a heavy area damage window.
defensives.id_note: Not cast in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Fade
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to shed threat and cut the damage you take while you reposition.

rules.description: Keep Shadow Word: Pain on your enemies
rules.action: Refresh Shadow Word: Pain as it nears expiry and spread it with offensive Penance.

rules.description: Bank Power Word: Radiance charges for Evangelism
rules.action: Spend spare charges on mini-ramps but keep two banked as Evangelism comes up.

rules.description: Shadow Word: Death replaces Smite in execute
rules.action: Swap your Smite filler to Shadow Word: Death once the target is in execute.

rules.description: Power Word: Shield at high Weal and Woe stacks
rules.action: Let Weal and Woe stack up before you shield, and cut shield casts when mana is low.

source_summary: Discipline is a ramping healer: apply Atonement ahead of a known damage window, then convert damage casts into healing. Evangelism is the main ramp on a 90 second timer, casting a free Power Word: Radiance and making the next two instant, so bank Radiance charges for it and save Ultimate Penitence for a separate heavy damage window. Between ramps keep Shadow Word: Pain up, press Mind Blast, Penance and Void Shield on cooldown, shield at high Weal and Woe stacks, and fill with Smite.
